![Tourist attraction in Thailand: 'Chiang Khan' – Rajamangala ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270358-1672-0139-0000-a7cef932716b:10)
Chiang Khan is `a charming, laid-back town in Loei Province, northeastern Thailand, set directly on the Mekong River` . Famous for its historic wooden shop-houses, vibrant evening walking street, and breathtaking river mists, it offers a highly authentic, relaxing retreat mostly favored by local Thai travelers.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chiang_Khan_district) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chiang_Khan_district)[[2]](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Chiang_Khan)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Njrl_HS-_V8&vl=en&t=335)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KUA_KyLP3IE)[[5]](https://www.feastographyblog.com/blog/chiang-khan-walking-street)

Must-See Attractions & Activities

- **Chiang Khan Walking Street (Chai Khong Road):** Running parallel to the Mekong, this pedestrian-only zone comes alive in the evening. It is packed with street food, handicrafts, and cafes housed in vintage teak buildings.
- **Phu Tok:** Located about 30 minutes south of the old town, this mountain is famous for its panoramic viewpoints and stunning "sea of mist" rolling over the river at sunrise.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Articles/nothing-but-chill-in-chiang-khan-loei) [[1]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Articles/nothing-but-chill-in-chiang-khan-loei)
- **Chiang Khan Skywalk:** Located about 19 kilometers west of the town, this clear, glass-bottomed observation deck sits perched high above the confluence of the Mekong and Hueang rivers.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Articles/nothing-but-chill-in-chiang-khan-loei) [[1]](https://horizonguides.com/thailand/chiang-khan)
- **Kaeng Khut Khu:** A set of rocky rapids in the Mekong River known for seasonal colorful rocks and scenic boat rides.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Tourism-g2044822-Chiang_Khan_Loei_Province-Vacations.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Tourism-g2044822-Chiang_Khan_Loei_Province-Vacations.html)
- **Morning Alms-Giving:** A deeply traditional cultural experience where you can offer sticky rice to monks at dawn along the walking streets or nearby temples.

Local Cuisine Chiang Khan offers unique Isaan (northeastern) and local Mekong delicacies. Don't miss *Khao Jee* (grilled sticky rice dipped in egg), *Mhok Kai* (steamed eggs wrapped in banana leaves), and fresh river fish dishes.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KUA_KyLP3IE) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7m5GZeYk3QI)[[2]](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/destinations/north-east-thailand/)Best Time to Visit The ideal time to visit is during the cool, dry season from **November to February** . During these months, the weather is pleasant, and you can experience the magical early-morning mist over the Mekong River.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5tYAPJomJ1o&vl=en&t=611) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5tYAPJomJ1o&vl=en&t=611)[[2]](https://www.thailandee.com/en/cities/chiang-khan)How to Get There Chiang Khan is located approximately 580 km from Bangkok. The most convenient way to travel is to fly from Bangkok to **Loei Airport (LOE)** , which takes about 1 hour. From there, it is about a 1-hour taxi or *songthaew* (shared truck) ride to Chiang Khan. You can also take an overnight bus directly from Bangkok's Mochit Terminal.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KUA_KyLP3IE) [[1]](https://goodtravel.guide/chiang-khan/)[[2]](https://www.expedia.com/Cheap-Flights-To-Chiang-Khan.d6309095.Travel-Guide-Flights)[[3]](https://www.agoda.com/en-sg/h49692571/hotel/chiangkhan-th.html)[[4]](https://itsbetterinthailand.com/provinces/chiang-rai/)For tips on how to get the most out of an evening stroll along the Mekong River and the walking street market:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRdw0FbEXK0aHk-DkI2ZiO0fuCEoU3mG4BclCVP-G-b45Yl5Bcc)

expanded_element.description: Chiang Khan is a lovely, quiet place. At sunset, I went for a stroll. The main attraction in Chiang Khan is the promenade, which runs behind the main road and offers views of the river and the opposite bank. Along the promenade, bars and restaurants were just getting ready for the evening crowds.

items.title: What is the history of Chiang Khan?

expanded_element.title: Chiang Khan
expanded_element.description: An ancient city with an interesting history, Chiang Khan had been relocated three times. Originally, it was an outpost town of the Vientiane Kingdom of Lao PDR., but after the Haw, a Chinese group from Yunnan, destroyed Chiang Khan, Vientiane and Luang Prabang, they moved to Pak Hueang.

items.title: What is the culture like in Chiang Khan?

expanded_element.title: Chiang Khan - Good Travel Guide
expanded_element.description: Chiang Khan's culture is steeped in centuries-old traditions that offer a rare glimpse into Thailand's rich heritage. Locals still participate in the traditional almsgiving ritual every morning, presenting sticky rice to Buddhist monks.
